definition_en: a piece of writing in a paper, or a word like a or the, or a single object
core_image: 摊开的报纸上一篇带标题的文章
scene: 早晨，一个人摊开报纸，读一篇关于新公园的文章。She read an article about the new park.
sceneCN: 这里 article 是「文章」（第 1 个义项：报刊上的一篇文字）；句意为她读了一篇关于新公园的文章。

senses.title: A piece of writing
senses.definition: a piece of writing on a subject in a newspaper or a magazine
senses.definitionCN: 报刊或杂志上关于某个主题的一篇文字
senses.example: She read an article about the new park.
senses.exampleCN: 她读了一篇关于新公园的文章。
senses.why: A small part cut from a larger text is the first sense of the Latin word.
senses.whyCN: 从大文本中分出来的一个小块，就是这个词的拉丁第一义。

senses.title: A grammatical word
senses.definition: a small word such as a, an or the used before a noun
senses.definitionCN: 放在名词前的小词，如 a、an 或 the
senses.example: The word the is a definite article.
senses.why: Grammar also cuts small separate words out of a sentence, and these keep the same name.
senses.whyCN: 语法同样从句子中分出独立的小词，这些词沿用同一名称。

senses.title: A single object
senses.definition: one object of a particular kind
senses.definitionCN: 某一类的单件物品
senses.example: The shop sells small articles for the home.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店出售家用小件物品。
senses.why: An item in a set is another separate piece, which gives the sense of a single object.
senses.whyCN: 一套中的一件也是独立的一块，于是有「单件物品」的义项。

definition_en: a person who makes art, or a skilled performer
core_image: 画室里一个人正给老人画肖像
scene: 画室里，一个人支起画架，正给一位老人画肖像。The artist painted a portrait of the old man.
sceneCN: 这里 artist 是「画家」（第 1 个义项：从事绘画创作的人）；句意为这位画家画了一幅老人的肖像。

senses.title: A maker of art
senses.definition: a person who paints, draws or makes works of art
senses.definitionCN: 绘画、素描或创作艺术品的人
senses.example: The artist painted a portrait of the old man.
senses.exampleCN: 这位画家画了一幅老人的肖像。
senses.why: Art is the skill and the person suffix marks the doer, so the maker of pictures is the first sense.
senses.whyCN: art 是技艺，表人的后缀标记执行者，所以作画的人就是第一义。

senses.title: A skilled performer
senses.definition: a person who performs an art with great skill
senses.definitionCN: 以高超技艺表演某种艺术的人
senses.example: The young artist sang beautifully on stage.
senses.exampleCN: 那位年轻艺人在台上唱得很动听。
senses.why: The same skill can be shown on a stage, so a singer or dancer also carries the name.
senses.whyCN: 同样的技艺也能在舞台上展现，所以歌手或舞者也用这个名称。

definition_en: in the same way, or in the role of, or at the time when, or because
core_image: 讲台上一名年轻人以老师的身份授课
scene: 学校里，一名年轻人每天站在讲台上给学生们上课。He works as a teacher.
sceneCN: 这里 as 是「作为」（第 2 个义项：以某种身份）；句意为他的工作是老师。

senses.title: In the same way
senses.definition: in the same way as another thing
senses.definitionCN: 与另一物以同样的方式
senses.example: She sings as sweetly as her sister.
senses.exampleCN: 她唱得和姐姐一样动听。
senses.why: All so meant just so, so lining up two things on one level is the first sense.
senses.whyCN: all so 意为正是如此，所以把两物摆在同一水平上就是第一义。

senses.title: In the role of
senses.definition: in the position or role of
senses.definitionCN: 处于某种身份或角色
senses.example: He works as a teacher.
senses.why: A person standing on the same level as a role is described by that role, which gives as meaning in the role of.
senses.whyCN: 一个人与某个角色处在同一位置，就用那个角色来描述他，于是 as 表示「作为」。

senses.title: At the time when
senses.definition: at the same time that something happens
senses.definitionCN: 在某事发生的同一时间
senses.example: As I walked home, it began to rain.
senses.exampleCN: 我走回家时，天开始下雨。
senses.why: Two events on one level in time are joined by the same word, which gives the sense of while.
senses.whyCN: 在时间上处于同一水平的两个事件也用同一个词连接，于是有「当……时」。

senses.title: Because
senses.definition: for the reason that
senses.definitionCN: 由于某个原因
senses.example: As it was late, we took a taxi.
senses.exampleCN: 因为时间晚了，我们坐了出租车。
senses.why: A reason standing beside a result is also lined up with it, which gives the sense of because.
senses.whyCN: 原因与结果并列在一起，也是被摆在同一水平上，于是有「因为」。

definition_en: to put a question, or to request something, or to invite someone
core_image: 工作人员抬头询问来人的名字
scene: 登记处，工作人员抬起头问来人的名字。She asked me my name.
sceneCN: 这里 asked 是「问」（第 1 个义项：提出询问）；句意为她问了我的名字。

senses.title: To put a question
senses.definition: to say a question in order to get an answer
senses.definitionCN: 说出问题以得到答复
senses.example: She asked me my name.
senses.why: The old verb meant to seek out, so going to someone for an answer is the first sense.
senses.whyCN: 古动词意为寻问，所以走向某人求答复就是第一义。

senses.title: To request something
senses.definition: to say that you want something to be given or done
senses.definitionCN: 说出希望得到某物或做成某事
senses.example: He asked for a glass of water.
senses.why: The seeking turns into a request when what is wanted is a thing rather than an answer.
senses.whyCN: 当所求的是一件东西而不是答复，寻问就变成请求。

senses.title: To invite someone
senses.definition: to invite a person to come somewhere
senses.definitionCN: 请某人到某处
senses.example: They asked us to the party.
senses.exampleCN: 他们邀请我们参加聚会。
senses.why: Inviting is asking a person to be present, so the same verb covers it.
senses.whyCN: 邀请就是请一个人到场，所以同一个动词也能表示。

definition_en: in a state of sleep, or without feeling in a part of the body
core_image: 婴儿在隔壁房间闭着眼睛安睡
scene: 隔壁房间里，婴儿闭着眼睛安静地睡着。The baby is asleep in the next room.

senses.title: In sleep
senses.definition: in a state of sleep
senses.definitionCN: 处在睡眠的状态

senses.exampleCN: 婴儿在隔壁房间睡着了。

senses.whyCN: 前缀标记处在某种状态，sleep 就是那种状态，所以睡着是第一义。

senses.definition: numb and unable to feel, often after pressure
senses.definitionCN: 麻木、感觉不到，常因受压而起

senses.why: A limb that has lost feeling seems shut in its own stillness, so the sleeping picture is borrowed.
senses.whyCN: 失去感觉的肢体像被关在自己的静止里，于是借用了「睡着」的画面。

senses.exampleCN: 他在家附近的一所学校上学。
senses.why: Stretching toward a school again and again becomes the regular act of attending it.
senses.whyCN: 一次次向学校伸展，就成了定期上学的行为。

senses.title: To take care of
senses.definition: to give care and help to a person or a matter

senses.whyCN: 朝有需要的人伸过去，就把这个词从「注意」变成「照料」。

definition_zh: 坏的；有害的；严重的；腐坏的
definition_en: of low quality, or harmful, or serious, or no longer fresh
core_image: 观众看到一半就离场的电影院
scene: 电影院里，观众看到一半就陆续离场。The film was bad, so we left early.
sceneCN: 这里 bad 是「坏的」（第 1 个义项：质量差、不好）；句意为电影很糟，所以我们提前离场。

pos.zh: 形容词：坏的；有害的；严重的；腐坏的

senses.title: Of low quality
senses.definition: of low quality or not good
senses.definitionCN: 质量差或不好
senses.example: The film was bad, so we left early.
senses.exampleCN: 电影很糟，所以我们提前离场。
senses.why: The old word simply named what is not good, so poor quality is the first sense.
senses.whyCN: 古词只表示「不好」，所以质量差就是第一义。

senses.title: Harmful
senses.definition: harmful or likely to cause trouble
senses.definitionCN: 有害或容易带来麻烦
senses.example: Too much sugar is bad for your teeth.
senses.why: What is not good can also work against a person, which gives the sense of harmful.
senses.whyCN: 不好的东西也可能对人不利，于是有「有害」的义项。

senses.title: Serious
senses.definition: serious or severe in degree
senses.definitionCN: 程度严重或厉害
senses.example: He has a bad cold.
senses.why: A thing that fails badly can fail in a large degree, which gives the sense of serious.
senses.whyCN: 坏起来的东西也可能坏得很厉害，于是有「严重」的义项。

senses.title: No longer fresh
senses.definition: no longer fresh and fit to eat
senses.definitionCN: 不再新鲜、不宜食用
senses.example: The milk has gone bad.
senses.why: Food that has stopped being what it should be is called bad, which gives the spoiled sense.
senses.whyCN: 食物不再保持应有的样子就被叫作 bad，于是有「变质」的义项。

items.en: A form badde appears in old English records.
items.cn: 古英语记录中出现 badde 这一形式。

items.en: Middle English used bad for what is not good.
items.cn: 中古英语用 bad 指不好的事物。

items.en: Later it covered harmful and serious things.
items.cn: 后来它也涵盖有害与严重的事物。

items.en: Today it also describes food that has spoiled.
items.cn: 今天它也形容变质的食物。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the recorded form, the real family and the phrases the word actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用有记录的词形、真实的词族和这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: The old form simply meant what is not good: bad names the failure of a thing to serve its purpose.
normal.cn: 古形式只表示「不好」：bad 指事物没能发挥它应有的作用。

normal.en: The same family also gives badly and worse.
normal.cn: 同一词族还给出 badly 与 worse。

normal.en: It often appears in the phrase a bad film.
normal.cn: 它常出现在「一部糟糕的电影」这个搭配里。

normal.en: Spell it as it sounds: keep every letter of bad in order.
normal.cn: 按读音拼写：把 bad 的每个字母按顺序保留。

normal.en: Use it when you mean: of low quality, or harmful, or serious, or no longer fresh.
normal.cn: 当你想表达「坏的」时用它。

abstract.cn: 同一幅画面在一句里可以是字面意思，在另一句里可以是比喻。

abstract.en: Say the word aloud first, then let the picture bring the meaning back.
abstract.cn: 先把这个词读出声，再让画面把意思带回来。
